license: Public-domain declaration transcribed from original README; no separate LICENSE existed.
changes: Original HTML/CSS/JS are bundled inline for a no-same-origin sandbox. Restrictive CSP blocks external connections, frames and media.
Clipboard tries the native API, then user-initiated execCommand, then selects visible text without claiming a successful copy.
Sandbox keyboard correction: Escape posts only the priyam-demo-close intent to the parent. The parent must verify event.source against the active iframe before closing.

Mobile-only compatibility CSS at 600px and below keeps original desktop styling: readable full-width panels, bounded inputs/media and touch targets. JSON Atlas stacks its input and output and scrolls code horizontally instead of squeezing two columns.
Publishing normalization: trailing whitespace removed; final newline normalized. No logic or layout change.
